text: Overdosage Overdosage may induce ventricular extrasystole and short paroxysms of ventricular tachycardia, a sensation of fullness in the head and tingling of the extremities. Should an excessive elevation of blood pressure occur, it may be immediately relieved by an a-adrenergic blocking agent (e.g. phentolamine). The oral LD50 in the rat is 350 mg/kg, in the mouse 120 mg/kg.
